findings.current: “That doesn’t matter. You’re delaying us. Move aside.”
findings.defect: The young man’s reply, “아직 조금 남았소” (“There’s still a little left”), is omitted before Commander Jeong says it does not matter. This removes a comic beat and makes the exchange jump directly from the question to the command.
findings.rationale: The Korean explicitly has the young man say he has a little more crying left before Commander Jeong tells him to move aside; the accepted baseline also preserves this reply as “Not quite.”
findings.replacement:
“There’s still a little left.”

“That doesn’t matter. You’re delaying us. Move aside.”

summary: The assembled English is largely faithful, but it omits a brief reply that the accepted baseline preserves and changes a sobbing sound into a hiccup.
